messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: [sev=page] GPU pool 'gpu-pool-4' experiencing sustained queue growth and increased token latency. Autoscaler alerts: HPA external metrics delayed. Paging on-call. https://alerts.internal/alert/6219003456 :rotating_light:

dana: Ack. I'm jumping in. Pulling perf dashboards and prometheus adapter logs now.

maria: Seeing external metrics backlog on prometheus-adapter: queue depth ~ 12k, handler latency spiking. HPA isn't receiving updated metrics so replicas stuck at 4 while pending pods/requests are piling up. 429s observed on inference API and elevated tail latencies.

eli: Can we get pod logs? pasting quick commands I'm running:

```bash
kubectl -n infra get pods -l app=prometheus-adapter -o wide
kubectl -n infra logs deployment/prometheus-adapter --tail=200\kubectl -n inference get hpa gpu-pool-4 -o yaml\``` 

eli: Adapter logs show repeated timeouts to Prometheus and GC pauses around the times queue jumps. Sample: `ERROR adapter: failed to fetch metrics: context deadline exceeded` repeated.

kira: Noted. Meanwhile queue on the serving side (grpc pending queue) is at 9.6k requests, and token-shedder is throttling down lower-priority customers. Putting a manual scale to buy time.

kira: Running: `kubectl -n inference scale deployment/gpu-pool-4 --replicas=10` :gear:

incident-bot: Manual scale applied by kira at 6219003600. Autoscaler will reconcile later.

sam: Restarting prometheus-adapter pod (rolling restart) might clear backlog but risks losing some metrics. Propose restart one replica, check backlog, then restart rest.

maria: Agree. Doing one-by-one restart now. Also enabling fallback metric for HPA (pod_pending_count) as interim so HPA can scale from a different signal.

ops-bot: Applying emergency config change: `hpa gpu-pool-4 -> minReplicas: 8`, and add fallback metrics binding. Config change ID: cfg-62190037.

maria: After restart of first adapter replica queue depth dropped to ~3.4k, external metrics latency improving. HPA target metrics updated, new replica count observed = 8 (scaling in progress).

sam: Noted that some exporters (node-exporter on a subset of infra nodes) had scrape errors causing adapter retries. Opening ticket for exporter patch after we stabilize.

eli: Quick customer impact summary for ops/comms:
- Symptoms: Increased inference latency and 429 throttles for some customers between 6219003456 and 6219005000.
- Affected customers: searchly, atlas (non-critical background jobs slowed), beta-key customers on gpu-pool-4 saw higher tail latencies.
- Mitigation: manual scale to 10, emergency hpa minReplicas bumped to 8, prometheus-adapter rolling restart, fallback metric enabled.

maria: Current state: queue length down to 600, CPU/GPU utilization stabilizing, error rate trending to baseline. Monitoring for reappearance for 30m.

dana: Good. Oncall handoff: I'm going offline in ~20m. Eli, can you take the next shift and own the postmortem? Please include timeline + metrics-adapter root-cause hypothesis.

eli: Taking it. I'll continue watch and start a timeline now. Notes added to post-incident doc: https://docs.internal/incidents/6219003456.

kira: Quick followups: 1) add circuit-breaker in prometheus-adapter to shed stale work earlier, 2) reduce adapter scrape concurrency to avoid GC spikes, 3) add alert for adapter queue depth > 2k.

maria: Also we'll contact affected customers with an incident summary + mitigation steps. Draft ready, will tag @growth for approvals.

incident-bot: INCIDENT: mitigated (reduced queue & recovered metrics signal) at 6219006700. Continued monitoring recommended. :white_check_mark:

eli: Ack, will keep monitoring and queue a follow-up RCA. handing to oncall-next complete.

dana: Thanks team. Great coordination. :thumbsup:
